gloss: a row, a line, single file

definitions.gloss: a row, a line, single file
definitions.explanation: A single line of people or things arranged in a row. Used for both horizontal rows and queues.

examples.japanese: {一列|いちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: To line up in a single row.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一列|いちれつ}になって⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The children walked in single file.
Cherry trees are planted in a row along the road.

notes:
{一列|いちれつ} means a single row or line of people or objects arranged in sequence.

FORMS:
⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧ (row, line). The same pattern forms {二列|にれつ} (two rows), {三列|さんれつ} (three rows), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一列|いちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in a single row
- {一列|いちれつ}になって⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk in single file
- {一列|いちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to form a single line
- {一列|いちれつ}{縦隊|じゅうたい}: single-file column (military/formal)

USAGE:
Common in instructions at schools, events, and public spaces. {一列|いちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (please line up in a single row) is a standard phrase.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧: row, line, queue
- ⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧: queue, procession
- ⟦{整列|せいれつ}→整列：15265_seiretsu⟧: lining up in an orderly fashion
